protocol.interleaving: rotating variant order within each round
protocol.timing: CUDA events, default stream; scalar output reset included for M1
protocol.bootstrap: 5000 paired-round resamples, percentile 95% CI of median and ratio of medians
protocol.exactness: Every warmup and measured sample: M1 exact scalar CPU reference; M2 every probe checked against CPU reference; M3/M4 every output element checked on GPU against uploaded CPU reference, mismatch flag copied to host
protocol.tenant_policy: nvidia-smi before and after every timed sample; foreign-tenant samples invalidated and retried; wait up to ten minutes for each occupied sample

layout.metadata: u64 base + u64 byte offset + u8 width per block, separate arrays
layout.for: 32-lane interleaved bit packing: lane l stores values l,l+32,... as one bit stream; 32-bit words transposed across lanes
layout.dictionary: global sorted distinct u64 values, densely assigned codes, packed or byte-aligned; dictionary decoding for all operations, no code-domain shortcut
layout.merge_output: Compact FOR output: a metadata kernel computes base/width and byte sizes, CUB exclusive scan builds compact offsets, and one 32-thread CTA per block packs output; all three stages are timed. Output capacity and CUB scratch are preallocated; output validation decodes all values

metric_limitations: Original modeled metrics are retained for reproducibility. Additional profile_* fields contain observed DRAM traffic from a separate NCU run, not simultaneous observations on the primary 21 timed samples; profiler replay/cache perturbation limits comparability.
M1 count modeled bytes = entire encoded footprint including dictionary. Q6 model weights each column footprint by its actual short-circuit visit fraction, not cache-line-rounded traffic.
M2 reports probes/s, not a bandwidth floor: binary search and variable expansion cannot be reduced to the full stored footprint per probe.

M3 model counts plain input+output; FOR model counts encoded input plus decoded input write/read and merged output write/read plus compact output bytes, but excludes repeated merge co-rank reads and metadata scan traffic. Therefore its fraction is a lower-bound traffic model, not attained physical bandwidth.
M4 floor = theoretical PCIe 4.0 x16 payload encoding limit 31.508 GB/s; end-to-end bytes variant includes all four metadata/data transfers plus decode and output writes. Host encoding excluded.
effort: One generic decoder shared by all kernels. Same block/grid/reduction/merge primitive for every variant. No variant-specific launch tuning, no parameter search, no code-domain dictionary optimization. Plain/bytes/FOR/dict use uniform runtime layout dispatch.
